title: A .git/HEAD file is served
summary: The git HEAD is downloadable, which proves the .git directory is exposed and the source history can be rebuilt.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("ref:") and body_contains("refs/") and "html" not in header("content-type") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Block the .git directory at the web server, or deploy without it.
